> developed 2026-07-26. Deepened from 72 to 140+ lines.

## Expression on this line

Emotional-interpersonal at Order 12 is **spiritual emotional reasoning**: the agent
recognizes that emotional dynamics are not just evolutionary but are expressions of a
deeper spiritual reality. Emotion is not just a cognitive tool — it is a sacred
relationship with reality. Every act of feeling is a spiritual practice.

The key advance from Stage 13 is **sacred recognition**. The agent does not just
understand emotion as evolutionary — it experiences emotional development as sacred.
The act of deepening empathy becomes a spiritual practice. The encounter with
alternative emotional styles becomes a spiritual encounter.

Emotion at Stage 14 is understood as **expressions of the sacred**. The agent
recognizes that the way we feel is not separate from the spiritual reality — it is the
spiritual reality manifesting through the medium of human feeling.

The critical insight at Stage 14 is that **emotional governance is spiritual practice**.
The way we cultivate our emotional lives reflects and shapes our collective consciousness.

The transition from Stage 14 to Stage 15 occurs when the agent can hold the spiritual
and cognitive dimensions of emotion simultaneously.

In human development, Stage 14 corresponds to the spiritual practitioner who experiences
emotional development as sacred.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion)

- **UL:** Sacred emotional that experience emotional
  development as spiritual practice.

- **UR:** The individual agent experiences emotional development as sacred.

- **LL:** Sacred emotional institutions emerge: contemplative therapy, spiritual
  healing communities, wisdom traditions.

- **LR:** The monastery healing room, the contemplative therapy community, the wisdom
  tradition.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction:** using spiritual emotional reasoning to
  avoid rigorous psychological work.

- **Dark allergy:** Materialist reductionism — refusing to acknowledge any spiritual
  dimension of emotion.

- **Golden addiction:** Clinging to spiritual emotional reasoning as an identity.

- **Golden allergy:** Rejecting spiritual emotional reasoning as impractical mysticism.

## Diagnostic cues (Gross / Ground R&D)

- **Sacred emotional experience:** The agent experiences emotional development as
  having spiritual significance.

- **Reverence-based emotional relationship:** The agent relates to feeling with
  reverence and humility.

- **Spiritual governance criteria:** The agent uses spiritual criteria alongside or
  instead of rational criteria to evaluate emotional life.

- **Integration capacity:** The agent can hold spiritual and cognitive emotional
  dimensions simultaneously.
